run.procedureSummary:
1. Charge: add each cycle's six charges to the contents. Overfill is allowed at this point.
2. Overflow: work through positions 1 to 6 in order. Any amount above a crucible's working volume is cut back to the volume and added to the next crucible before that crucible's turn, so it can cascade. Position 6's excess goes to slag.
3. State: test the post-overflow contents. BASE at or above its upper mark becomes SUPERHEATED. SUPERHEATED at or below its lower mark becomes BASE. Anything else stays as it is, and every change is logged.
4. Bleed: work out all six amounts first, from the post-overflow contents and the newly updated states, rounding down. BASE sends floor(c/4) to slag. SUPERHEATED sends floor(c/2) to position i-1, except position 1, whose amount goes to slag. All transfers then happen at once. Any overfill this creates stays until the next cycle's overflow step, and after cycle 5 it stays for good.
5. Emergency tap: if the total of the six is strictly above 38, each crucible keeps floor(c/2) and the rest goes to slag.

openPoints.point: Which contents the state test uses
openPoints.assumption: The contents after the overflow step, since the steps run in order.

openPoints.point: Which state and contents the bleed uses
openPoints.assumption: The state just set in step 3 and the post-overflow contents. All amounts are worked out before anything moves (simultaneous move).

openPoints.point: Crucibles that start at or above their upper mark (position 2 starts at 6, which equals its mark of 6)
openPoints.assumption: The state is only tested at step 3, so every crucible starts BASE whatever its contents.

openPoints.point: Return-launder inflow that pushes a crucible over its working volume during bleed (for example position 2 holding 10 against a volume of 8 after bleed in cycles 1, 4 and 5)
openPoints.assumption: The overfill stays where it is until the next cycle's overflow step, and after cycle 5 it stays at the end.
Strictly greater than 38. In cycle 5 the post-bleed total is exactly 38, so the tap did not fire.

openPoints.point: When the tap test happens and what it tests
openPoints.assumption: Once per cycle, after the bleed, on the total of all six crucibles. The tap does not change any states.
Always round down (floor) for bleed amounts and for the half each crucible keeps on a tap. The remainder goes to slag on a tap.

run.balanceCheck: Starting melt 20 + all charges 94 = 114. End melt 38 (6+10+9+7+4+2) + slag tally 76 = 114. The two sides match.
